description: One data row of central/identity_map.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

actor_key.description: Keyed hash of the provider's own actor id, for an actor that is not resolved to a person.

actor_kind.description: What the actor is: user, proxy user, end user, service account, API key or unassigned; mixed if merged records differ.

method.description: How the identity map matches the actor: login, email, id or non_person.

person_key.description: Pseudonymous person key; empty when method is non_person.

provider.description: Provider the usage or seats came from, as the silver records name it.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

valid_from.description: First day the row is valid.

valid_to.description: Last day the row is valid; empty if open.

title: gold-dataset-identity_map
x-grain: One row per provider actor and validity period.
